newsitem.title: USA: Europa says needs one more ok for casino.
newsitem.headline: Europa says needs one more ok for casino.

text.p: Europa Cruises Corp said Tuesday it received final approval from the Mississippi Commission of Environmental Quality for its casino resort in Diamondhead, Mississippi.
The company said it is needs one more permit, from the U.S. Army Corp of Engineers, to begin constructing the resort.
The company said the Commission on Environmental Quality decision followed a two-day hearing that had been requested by opponents, and which was required under the commissions' rules.
Europa Cruises, through its wholly owned subsidiary Casino World Inc, plans to build a casino resort and hotel at its 404-acre site in Diamondhead, Mississippi.
